app.name: Wayfare
app.description: The stories of Ho Chi Minh City's places, told in your language.
footer.line: Wayfare tells the stories of Ho Chi Minh City's places. No place pays to be told first.
lang.title: Language
lang.lead: The pages and the stories. Stories not yet in your language play in English, or as written.
lang.unsupported: Shown in English — your browser's language isn't on Wayfare yet.
error.network: No connection. Try again once you're online.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries. Wait a moment, then try again.
notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.body: The link may be mistyped, or the page has moved.
player.held: Your browser held the sound back until you tap — that's how browsers protect you from pages that play by themselves.
player.upNext: Up next · starts when this ends
player.nothingWaiting: Nothing waiting. Play next on another place to queue it.
player.preparingNote: A moment — preparing the story in {language}
player.liveNote: Read live while the recording is made — the voice may pause for a moment
player.voiceTitle: Read by your browser's own voice — you're offline, and this story hasn't been played on this browser
player.voiceTitleOnline: Read by your browser's own voice — Wayfare has no recording in this language
player.voiceNote: Your browser's voice: less natural than the recording. The recording plays once you're back online.
player.cantPlay: The story can't play offline: its recording isn't saved on this browser, and your browser has no {language} voice to read it. It plays once you're back online.
player.cantPlayOnline: The story can't play right now. Try again in a moment.
place.menuMeta: {n, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} · prices in {currency}
place.seeOnMap: See it on the map of {area}
place.shownAs: Shown in {language}, as the venue wrote it — the {page} version is being written.
place.shownAsSource: Shown in {language}, as it was written — the {page} version is being written.
place.voiceOffer: Or let your browser read it aloud in {language} — its own voice, less natural.
app.bar: The app tells stories as you walk
gone.title: This place is no longer on Wayfare
gone.body: Its story can't play any more — the place has closed, or left Wayfare. Here is what's near its sticker.
code.title: Type the code
code.lead: Type the 8 letters and numbers printed under the QR on the Wayfare sticker.
code.label: Code
code.help: 8 characters — lower case, spaces and hyphens are fine.
code.scan: Or scan it with your phone's camera — it opens this page
code.sticker: A Wayfare sticker: the code is printed under the QR, {code}
code.none: No place has the code {code}. Check the 8 characters against the sticker.
code.letterU: Wayfare codes never use the letter U. Check the sticker.
code.symbol: A code has only letters and numbers. Check the sticker.
code.goneTitle: This place is no longer on Wayfare
code.goneBody: The code {code} belonged to a place that has closed or left Wayfare.
place.preparingLanguage: We're preparing {language} — shown in English for now.
map.title: Map
map.label: Map of {area}
map.none: No places here yet. Move the map, or choose another area.
map.locBody: Your browser will ask for your location. Wayfare uses it on this page only, to sort what's near — it is never stored or sent with your name.
map.locOff: Location is off — showing {area}. To use it, allow location for {host} in your browser's settings.
map.areasLater: More areas of Ho Chi Minh City come later.
map.areaPlacesAway: {n, plural, one {# place} other {# places}} · {distance} from you
map.outsideBody: Wayfare covers two areas of Ho Chi Minh City for now. Pick one to explore its places — their stories play from anywhere.
map.slow: Slow connection — the list is ready below
map.offlineBody: You haven't opened this map before. Places you've opened still work below.
offer.title: Saved on this browser
offer.body: With a free account, your saved places follow you to your phone, your computer and the Wayfare app.
auth.name: Name
auth.agreeRequired: Agree to the terms and privacy policy to create an account.
signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.lead: Free. Your saved places follow you; nothing else changes.
signUp.takenBody: {email} already has a Wayfare account. Sign in, or use another address.
signUp.takenField: This email already has an account.
signUp.checkBody: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your address; your account works meanwhile.
signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Your saved places come with you.
signIn.wrong: That email and password don't match.
forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.lead: Type your account's email: we send a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account uses this address, we sent a link.
gLink.title: Link Google to your account
gLink.body: {email} already has a Wayfare account with a password. Enter it once to link Google; then you can sign in either way.
gLink.expired: Google's sign-in took too long. Try Continue with Google again.
gLink.notLinked: You're signed in, but Google isn't linked yet: the request expired. Link it from your account page.
fav.title: Saved places
fav.lead: On every device you sign in to.
fav.leadAnonymous: On this browser. Sign in to keep them on every device.
fav.emptyBody: Tap the heart on a place to keep it here. On this browser it needs no account.
fav.mergedBody: {n, plural, one {# place} other {# places}} saved on your other devices are here now, with the {m} you saved on this browser.
acc.title: Your account
acc.name: Name
acc.checkEmail: Check your email: we sent a link to {email}. Your account works meanwhile.
acc.needPassword: Set a password first, so you can still sign in without Google.
acc.deleteBody: Your account, name, email and saved places are deleted for good. Stories you heard and this browser's anonymous use stay, with no link to you.
acc.deleteConfirmBody: This can't be undone. {n, plural, =0 {Your name and email are} one {Your name, email and # saved place are} other {Your name, email and # saved places are}} deleted now. Type your password to confirm.
acc.changeEmailBody: We send a link to the new address; the change happens once you open it.
acc.unlinkBody: You'll sign in with your email and password. Type your password to confirm.
link.verifiedBody: {email} is confirmed. Your saved places are safe on every device you sign in to.
link.confirmedBody: Wayfare now writes to {email}. We told your old address too.
link.revertedBody: The change is undone, and every other session is signed out. If you didn't ask for it, change your password now.
link.expiredBody: It was used already, or it's older than 24 hours. Ask for a new one from your account page.
link.otherTitle: This link is for another account
link.otherBody: You're signed in as {email}, but the link is for {other}. Sign out, then open the link again.
error.EMAIL_TAKEN: This email already has an account.
error.emailInvalid: Enter an email address, like mai@example.com.
error.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: This account is locked for now. Try again later.
error.GOOGLE_SIGN_IN_NOT_ALLOWED: This account signs in with its password.
error.INVALID_GOOGLE_TOKEN: Google couldn't confirm the sign-in. Try again.
wo.androidTitle: Wayfare for Android tells stories as you walk
wo.androidBody: The app starts each place's story as you reach it, with your phone in your pocket, and keeps whole areas for offline use. The web plays a story when you tap it.
wo.iosTitle: Keep Wayfare on your Home Screen
wo.iosBody: It opens like an app, full screen, and remembers the places you opened.
wo.iosStep1: Tap Share at the bottom of Safari
wo.offline: You're offline. Places you've opened, their photos and stories you've played still work; the map and new places wait for a connection.
wo.notSavedTitle: This page isn't saved on this browser
wo.notSavedBody: You opened {places} while online; they still work. This one needs a connection.
legal.untranslated: Not yet translated into {language} — this is the English text, and the English text is the one that applies.
settings.title: Settings
settings.homeScreen: Add Wayfare to your Home Screen
settings.version: Wayfare web · version {version} · Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors
map.sponsoredNote: Sponsored places are boosted by their owners and rise a little in this list and on the map. A boost never changes which stories play, or when.
map.offlineList: Offline: the list is by distance, as last loaded, and nothing is sponsored.
